english: The most useful support is usually the kind that helps me understand the pattern, not just this one fix.
portuguese: A ajuda mais útil costuma ser a que me ajuda a perceber o padrão, e não apenas esta correção isolada.
pronunciationNote: ah ah-ZHOO-dah mysh OO-teel koosh-TOO-mah sair ah k m ah-ZHOO-dah ah pair-seh-BER oo pah-DROWN, ee nown ah-PEH-nash ESH-tah koh-rreh-SOWN ee-zoh-LAH-dah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se percebo a lógica, ganho autonomia da próxima vez.
exampleSentences.english: If I understand the logic, I gain autonomy next time.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I try to separate urgent messages from important ones, because they are not always the same thing.
portuguese: Tento separar mensagens urgentes de mensagens importantes, porque nem sempre são a mesma coisa.
pronunciationNote: TEN-too seh-pah-RAR men-SAH-zhensh oor-ZHEN-tesh d men-SAH-zhensh eem-pohr-TAN-tesh, poor-k neng SAYM-pr sown ah MAYZ-mah KOY-zah

exampleSentences.portuguese: O que chega a correr pode não ser o que mais merece tempo.
exampleSentences.english: What arrives urgently may not be what most deserves time.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: If the tool saves me time individually but makes coordination harder for everyone else, I am not sure it is worth it.
portuguese: Se a ferramenta me poupa tempo individualmente mas dificulta a coordenação para toda a gente, não sei se compensa.
pronunciationNote: s ah fair-rah-MEN-tah m POU-pah TEM-poo een-dee-vee-doo-al-MEN-t mahz dee-fee-KOOL-tah ah koor-deh-nah-SOWN PAH-rah TOH-dah ah ZHEN-t, nown say s kong-PEN-sah

exampleSentences.portuguese: A eficiência individual nem sempre melhora o sistema todo.
exampleSentences.english: Individual efficiency does not always improve the whole system.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I am wary of updates that promise simplicity but actually remove useful control.
portuguese: Desconfio de atualizações que prometem simplicidade mas na prática retiram controlo útil.
pronunciationNote: desh-kon-FEE-oo d ah-too-ah-lee-zah-SOINSH k proh-MEH-teng seem-plee-see-DAH-d mahz nah PRAH-tee-kah rreh-TEE-rang kon-TROH-loo OO-teel

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem tudo o que parece mais simples é realmente melhor para quem usa.
exampleSentences.english: Not everything that seems simpler is actually better for the user.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: The real value of a digital tool usually appears when it quietly supports a habit you already want to keep.
portuguese: O verdadeiro valor de uma ferramenta digital costuma aparecer quando apoia discretamente um hábito que já queres manter.
pronunciationNote: oo vair-dah-DAY-roo vah-LOR d OO-mah fair-rah-MEN-tah dee-zhee-TAL koosh-TOO-mah ah-pah-reh-SAIR KWAN-doo ah-POI-ah deesh-kreh-tah-MEN-t oom AH-bee-too k zhah KEH-resh man-TAIR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo encaixa naturalmente, quase nos esquecemos da ferramenta em si.
exampleSentences.english: When everything fits naturally, we almost forget the tool itself.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I would rather ask a few extra questions than make assumptions and create the wrong account, file, or setting.
portuguese: Prefiro fazer mais algumas perguntas do que assumir coisas e criar a conta, o ficheiro ou a definição errada.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo fah-ZAIR mysh al-GOO-mash pair-GOON-tash doo k ah-soo-MEER KOY-zash ee kree-AR ah KON-tah, oo fee-SHAY-roo oo ah deh-fee-nee-SOWN eh-RRAH-dah
notes: Useful in setup and admin contexts.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Corrigir depois quase sempre demora mais do que clarificar antes.
exampleSentences.english: Fixing it afterwards almost always takes longer than clarifying it beforehand.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: The best online spaces for me are the ones that allow depth without demanding constant performance.
portuguese: Os melhores espaços online para mim são os que permitem profundidade sem exigirem desempenho constante.
pronunciationNote: oosh meh-LYOH-resh esh-PAH-soosh on-LINE PAH-rah meeng sown oosh k pair-MEE-teng proh-foon-dee-DAH-d seng eh-zhee-ZHEE-reng dehsh-em-PEN-yoo konsh-TAN-t
notes: Useful in conversations about online communities.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se tudo vira montra, fico com menos vontade de participar.
exampleSentences.english: If everything turns into a shop window, I feel less like taking part.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I find it easier to concentrate when I choose one communication channel for each kind of conversation.
portuguese: Acho mais fácil concentrar-me quando escolho um canal de comunicação para cada tipo de conversa.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo mysh FAH-seel kon-seng-TRAR-m KWAN-doo esh-KOL-yoo oom kah-NAL d koh-moo-nee-kah-SOWN PAH-rah KAH-dah TEE-poo d kon-VEHR-sah
notes: Useful in work and personal communication discussions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se tudo acontece em todo o lado, perco o fio com facilidade.
exampleSentences.english: If everything happens everywhere, I lose the thread easily.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: I can tolerate a rough interface if the underlying logic is solid and respectful of my time.
portuguese: Consigo tolerar uma interface menos polida se a lógica de base for sólida e respeitar o meu tempo.
pronunciationNote: kon-SEE-goo toh-leh-RAR OO-mah een-ter-FAIS MEN-oosh pol-LEE-dah s ah LOH-zhee-kah d BAH-s for SOH-lee-dah ee resh-pay-TAR oo may-oo TEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: O acabamento visual impressiona; a estrutura é que me faz ficar.
exampleSentences.english: The visual polish impresses; the structure is what makes me stay.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: When a service fails silently instead of clearly, it creates twice as much uncertainty.
portuguese: Quando um serviço falha em silêncio em vez de falhar claramente, cria o dobro da incerteza.
pronunciationNote: KWAN-doo oom sair-VEE-soo FAH-lyah eng see-LEN-see-oo eng vez d FAH-lyar klah-RAH-men-t, KREE-ah oo DOH-broo dah een-ser-TEH-zah
notes: Useful in support and design discussions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se eu soubesse logo o que aconteceu, resolvia muito mais depressa.
exampleSentences.english: If I knew immediately what had happened, I would solve it much faster.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: The tools I keep returning to are usually not the most exciting ones, but the ones that stay dependable under pressure.
portuguese: As ferramentas a que volto acabam por não ser as mais entusiasmantes, mas sim as que continuam fiáveis sob pressão.
pronunciationNote: az fair-rah-MEN-tash ah k VOL-too ah-KAH-bang poor nown sair az mysh en-too-zee-ahz-MAN-tesh, mahz seeng az k kon-TEE-noo-ang fee-AH-veish sob preh-SOWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: No dia a dia, a consistência vale mais do que o brilho inicial.
exampleSentences.english: In day-to-day life, consistency matters more than initial excitement.

subject: Technology & Online Life
english: If digital life is going to take up so much space, I at least want it arranged in a way that supports how I think.
portuguese: Se a vida digital vai ocupar tanto espaço, ao menos quero tê-la organizada de uma forma que apoie a maneira como penso.
pronunciationNote: s ah VEE-dah dee-zhee-TAL vy oh-koo-PAR TAN-too esh-PAH-soo, ow MEN-oosh KEH-roo TAY-lah or-gah-nee-ZAH-dah d OO-mah FOR-mah k ah-POI-ah ah mah-NAY-rah KOH-moo PEN-soo
notes: Useful in reflective conversation about technology.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se a ferramenta molda os meus dias, quero que essa influência seja consciente e não acidental.
exampleSentences.english: If a tool shapes my days, I want that influence to be conscious rather than accidental.
